news.title: Consensus EPS estimates fall by 10%
news.body: The consensus outlook for fiscal year 2027 has been updated. 2027 EPS estimate fell from ₹65.73 to ₹59.00 per share. Revenue forecast steady at ₹270.3b. Net income forecast to grow 61% next year vs 8.7% growth forecast for Telecom industry in India. Consensus price target broadly unchanged at ₹1,903. Share price rose 5.1% to ₹1,602 over the past week.

news.title: New minor risk - Profit margin trend
news.body: The company's profit margins are lower than last year and have reduced by more than 30%. Net profit margin: 4.2% Last year net profit margin: 7.0% This is considered a minor risk. A large drop in profit margin could indicate the company does not have strong competitive advantages or it is yet to establish itself and its core business. Even if it is a well established business, this may make it a much riskier investment than one that has a combination of proven competitive advantages and a stable or growing profit margin. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risk Interest payments are not well covered by earnings (2.6x net interest cover). Minor Risks Unstable dividend paying track record with dividend experiencing an annual drop of over 20% in the past

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS misses analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹36.62 (down from ₹56.99 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹248.0b (up 7.3% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹10.4b (down 36% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 4.2% (down from 7.0% in FY 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue was in line with analyst estimates. Earnings per share (EPS) missed analyst estimates by 21%. Revenue is forecast to grow 8.3% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 3.6% growth forecast for the Telecom industry in Asia. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 3% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 8% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings: EPS exceeds analyst expectations
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹12.82 (up from ₹9.01 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹61.9b (up 6.7% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹3.65b (up 42% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 5.9% (up from 4.4% in 3Q 2025). Revenue was in line with analyst estimates. Earnings per share (EPS) surpassed analyst estimates by 25%. Revenue is forecast to grow 9.0% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 3.9% growth forecast for the Telecom industry in Asia. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 5% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 6% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.

news.title: Tata Communications Limited Appoints Ganesh Lakshminarayanan as Managing Director
news.body: Tata Communications Limited disclosed that the board of directors have appointed industry veteran Ganesh Lakshminarayanan as the Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer (Designate) of the company, according to an exchange filing. The board of directors of the company, at its meeting held on January 21, 2026, has selected Ganesh Lakshminarayanan to be appointed as Managing Director & Chief Executive Officer (Designate) of Tata Communications Limited. Lakshminarayanan's permanent appointment will be effective from a future date upon receiving the necessary regulatory approvals from the stock exchanges and the regulators. Ganesh Lakshminarayanan is recognized as an industry veteran, indicating his extensive experience and expertise in the field.

news.title: Tata Communications Limited Appoints Ganesh Lakshminarayanan as CEO
news.body: Tata Communications announced on 21 January 2026, disclosed that the board of directors have appointed industry veteran Ganesh Lakshminarayanan as the Chief Executive Officer (Designate) of the company, according to an exchange filing. The board of directors of the company, at its meeting held on 21 January 2026, has selected Ganesh Lakshminarayanan to be appointed as Managing Director & Chief Executive Officer (Designate) of Tata Communications Limited," the company informed the stock exchanges. Lakshminarayanan's permanent appointment will be effective from a future date upon receiving the necessary regulatory approvals from the stock exchanges and the regulators.
